## 附录：工具自带文件清单（参考，可跳过）

[](#附录工具自带文件清单参考可跳过)

以下为工具仓库与全局钩子的目录结构，仅供了解内部实现参考。

`repo sync` 拉取的工程结构如下。`.claude/` 为工具仓库（与 demo 仓库平级）。`install.sh` 采用**零侵入**设计。demo 仓库中**在工作区内首次结束 AI 会话后**会自动出现 `logs/` 目录。

```
<你的工作树>/                            # repo init 拉取的工作树根目录
├── .repo/                              # repo 工作区标识
├── .claude/                            # 大赛工具仓库（open-vela/.claude）
│   └── skills/contest-log-collector/
│       ├── adapters/                   # 核心采集逻辑
│       ├── tools/                      # 同步与校验工具
│       └── onboarding/
│           ├── install.sh              # 安装脚本
│           └── verify-setup.sh         # 健康检查
├── nuttx/  apps/  vendor/  ...         # openvela 全量源码
└── <你的 demo 仓>/                      # 例如 contest2026_042_openvela
    ├── (你的代码、README、配置)
    └── logs/                           # 首次结束 AI 会话后自动生成
        └── <your-github-login>/
            ├── manifest.json
            └── <date>/<tool>__<sid>.jsonl
```

此外，`install.sh` 会在 home 目录部署全局状态（**这些文件不进入 demo 仓库**）：

```
~/.claude/
├── settings.json                       # 挂载会话结束钩子
├── contest-collector.env               # 身份信息
└── contest-collector-staging/          # 本机缓冲区
    └── <your-github-login>/
        └── <date>/<tool>__<sid>.jsonl

~/.config/opencode/plugin/
└── contest-collector.js                # OpenCode 插件

~/.local/bin/
└── contest-snapshot                    # 便捷脚本
```

采集器不会自动执行网络上传，仅在本机工作区内流转日志，最终提交由参赛者自行通过 git 完成。 **demo 仓库中除 `logs/` 目录外不会出现任何采集器相关文件。**

+#include "deskmate_client.h"
+
+#include <stdio.h>
+#include <string.h>
+
+static void copy_bounded(char *out, size_t out_size, const char *value)
+{
+  if (out_size == 0) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (value == NULL) {
+    out[0] = '\0';
+    return;
+  }
+
+  strncpy(out, value, out_size - 1);
+  out[out_size - 1] = '\0';
+}
+
+static void clear_prompt(struct deskmate_client_s *client)
+{
+  memset(&client->prompt, 0, sizeof(client->prompt));
+  client->has_prompt = false;
+}
+
+void deskmate_client_init(struct deskmate_client_s *client, const char *nonce)
+{
+  memset(client, 0, sizeof(*client));
+  copy_bounded(client->nonce, sizeof(client->nonce), nonce);
+  client->state = DESKMATE_OFFLINE;
+}
+
+void deskmate_client_link_down(struct deskmate_client_s *client)
+{
+  client->epoch[0] = '\0';
+  client->next_seq = 0;
+  client->last_snapshot_ms = 0;
+  client->summary[0] = '\0';
+  clear_prompt(client);
+  client->state = DESKMATE_OFFLINE;
+}
+
+bool deskmate_client_snapshot(struct deskmate_client_s *client,
+                              const struct deskmate_snapshot_s *snapshot,
+                              uint32_t now_ms)
+{
+  if (snapshot == NULL || snapshot->connection_nonce == NULL ||
+      snapshot->epoch == NULL ||
+      strcmp(snapshot->connection_nonce, client->nonce) != 0) {
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  if (client->epoch[0] == '\0') {
+    copy_bounded(client->epoch, sizeof(client->epoch), snapshot->epoch);
+    client->next_seq = 1;
+  }
+
+  if (strcmp(snapshot->epoch, client->epoch) != 0 ||
+      snapshot->seq != client->next_seq) {
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  client->next_seq++;
+  client->last_snapshot_ms = now_ms;
+  copy_bounded(client->summary, sizeof(client->summary), snapshot->summary);
+  if (snapshot->prompt == NULL) {
+    clear_prompt(client);
+  } else {
+    client->prompt = *snapshot->prompt;
+    client->prompt.id[DESKMATE_PROMPT_ID_MAX] = '\0';
+    client->prompt.tool[DESKMATE_TOOL_MAX] = '\0';
+    client->prompt.hint[DESKMATE_HINT_MAX] = '\0';
+    client->has_prompt = true;
+  }
+
+  if (client->has_prompt) {
+    client->state = DESKMATE_ATTENTION;
+  } else if (snapshot->running > 0) {
+    client->state = DESKMATE_BUSY;
+  } else {
+    client->state = DESKMATE_IDLE;
+  }
+
+  return true;
+}
+
+bool deskmate_client_timeout(struct deskmate_client_s *client, uint32_t now_ms)
+{
+  if (client->state == DESKMATE_OFFLINE ||
+      now_ms - client->last_snapshot_ms <= 30000U) {
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  deskmate_client_link_down(client);
+  return true;
+}
+
+bool deskmate_client_build_decision(const struct deskmate_client_s *client,
+                                    enum deskmate_decision_e decision,
+                                    char *out, size_t out_size)
+{
+  const char *value;
+  int written;
+
+  if (!client->has_prompt || out == NULL || out_size == 0) {
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  if (decision == DESKMATE_DECISION_ONCE && client->prompt.can_once) {
+    value = "once";
+  } else if (decision == DESKMATE_DECISION_DENY && client->prompt.can_deny) {
+    value = "deny";
+  } else {
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  written = snprintf(out, out_size,
+                     "{\"v\":1,\"cmd\":\"permission\",\"connection_nonce\":\"%s\",\"epoch\":\"%s\",\"id\":\"%s\",\"decision\":\"%s\"}",
+                     client->nonce, client->epoch, client->prompt.id, value);
+  return written >= 0 && (size_t)written < out_size;
+}
+
+const char *deskmate_state_name(enum deskmate_state_e state)
+{
+  switch (state) {
+    case DESKMATE_OFFLINE: return "Offline";
+    case DESKMATE_IDLE: return "Idle";
+    case DESKMATE_BUSY: return "Busy";
+    case DESKMATE_ATTENTION: return "Attention";
+    case DESKMATE_RESULT: return "Result";
+    default: return "Unknown";
+  }
+}

+};
+

+  char epoch[DESKMATE_EPOCH_MAX + 1];

对，整体思路是对的，但更推荐这样做：

```text
dev
  日常开发，保留多个细粒度 commit
  ├─ feat: transport
  ├─ feat: UI/controller
  ├─ fix: stack overflow
  └─ logs: backfill ...

trunk
 只保留经过测试、准备推送的少量稳定 commit
  ├─ feat: release DeskMate MQTT milestone
  └─ logs: backfill AI sessions
```

关键点是：**不需要先 pick 成多个 commit，再 squash。**  
直接在 `trunk` 使用 `cherry-pick --no-commit`，把选中的 `dev` 提交的文件改动一次性放入暂存区；测试通过后再创建一个稳定 commit。

## 正常发布流程

在 `dev` 开发并形成若干本地提交：

```bash
git switch dev

# 日常开发
git add app/deskmate tools/acp-bridge
git commit -s -m "feat: ..."

# 日志单独提交
git add logs
git commit -s -m "logs: backfill AI sessions"
```

准备发布时，切换到 `trunk`：

```bash
git switch trunk
```

先看哪些 `dev` 提交尚未被纳入：

```bash
git log --oneline trunk..dev
```

然后挑选需要发布的代码提交，但不立即生成多个 commit：

```bash
git cherry-pick --no-commit <代码提交1> <代码提交2> <代码提交3>
```

此时变更只进入暂存区。运行测试、检查 diff：

```bash
git diff --cached
git diff --cached --check
```

确认后压成一个稳定代码提交：

```bash
git commit -s -m "feat: release DeskMate MQTT milestone"
```

日志建议保持独立提交，不和代码混合：

```bash
git cherry-pick <日志提交SHA>
```

或者如果日志还没有提交，也可以在 `trunk` 官方重建并验证后：

```bash
contest-snapshot --backfill --source sqlite --github-login C-Luv9615 \
  --dest "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" --force --confirm

python3 ../.claude/skills/contest-log-collector/tools/validate-log.py logs/

git add logs
git commit -s -m "logs: backfill AI sessions"
```

最后推送：

```bash
git push -u origin trunk
```

## 为什么这样比“pick 后 squash”好

如果你先普通 cherry-pick：

```bash
git cherry-pick A
git cherry-pick B
git cherry-pick C
```

然后再 squash，需要 `reset --soft`、interactive rebase 或 amend，操作更多，也更容易误改历史。

直接：

```bash
git cherry-pick --no-commit A B C
git commit ...
```

效果相同，但更安全：

```text
多个 dev 提交
       ↓
trunk 暂存区
       ↓
一次测试
       ↓
一个稳定代码 commit
```

你当前的 `trunk` 与 `dev` 的 DeskMate/bridge 代码内容已经一致，所以**不要再对当前这些历史提交重新 cherry-pick**，否则大概率会得到空提交或冲突。

```text

dc4a4fe logs: backfill AI sessions
```

另外，你刚才在 `trunk` 上查看时，自动日志采集又生成了一个未跟踪 JSONL。以后建议：

- 日常 AI 开发和日志自动生成：尽量在 `dev`；
- `trunk`：只用于整理、验证、推送；
- 若 `trunk` 因查看操作自动产生 logs，回到 `dev` 后用官方工具完整 backfill，再按 `logs:` 单独提交。

最简短的规则就是：

```text
dev：随时提交细粒度开发历史
trunk：只 cherry-pick --no-commit 选中的 dev 提交，测试后压成稳定提交
logs：始终独立 commit
```

```text
feat: add DeskMate MQTT bridge and OpenVela client

Add the DeskMate MQTT prototype across the PC bridge and OpenVela device
application.

PC bridge:
- add ACP adapters for MiMoCode and Kiro
- normalize session updates into DeskMate snapshots
- map exact once/deny decisions back to ACP option IDs
- provide MQTT and Unix-loop transports with nonce, epoch, sequence,
  timeout, and duplicate-decision handling
- keep raw tool input out of ordinary status messages; expose only
  redacted permission hints and semantic tool titles
- cap snapshot msg at 128 UTF-8 bytes with safe ellipsis truncation

OpenVela client:
- add the deskmate application and manifest mapping
- add MQTT-C transport, protocol state core, controller, and foreground
  console adapter
- derive Offline, Idle, Busy, Attention, and Result states locally
- accept once/deny only for the active prompt and prevent local duplicate
  decisions
- deduplicate unchanged heartbeat display updates
- use an 8 KiB task stack to avoid the Goldfish UART IRQ/FPU context-save
  overflow observed with the original 4 KiB stack

Usage:
1. Start a LAN-reachable Mosquitto broker.
2. Start the bridge:
   bin/deskmate-demo.sh bridge kiro mqtt \
     --broker mqtt://<broker-ip>:1883 --device-id goldfish-1
3. Start the OpenVela client:
   deskmate -h <broker-ip> -p 1883 \
     -u <username> -w <password> -d goldfish-1
4. Use the foreground DeskMate> prompt to enter once or deny when an
   Attention snapshot presents a pending permission request.

Verification:
- DeskMate host protocol/controller/console tests
- ACP bridge test suite, including loop and local MQTT broker coverage
- AArch64 target source compilation
- Goldfish MQTT end-to-end permission flows verified with both Kiro and
  MiMoCode

USB CDC, BK7258 board bring-up, GPIO keys, LCD/LED integration, and
hardware acceptance remain out of scope for this prototype.

Signed-off-by: chenzepei3 <chenzepei3@xiaomi.com>
```

  "# DeskMate OpenVela Client

This is the team 272 OpenVela application client. It follows the frozen
DeskMate Link contract without depending on ACP, Node.js, Unix sockets, or a
board peripheral.

`deskmate_client.c` is the portable protocol state core.
`deskmate_controller.c` owns the active protocol session and routes an approved
or denied current prompt through its active transport. `deskmate_mqtt.c` is the
first transport: it uses NuttX MQTT-C over ordinary TCP, publishes complete JSON
messages, and subscribes to bridge messages. It does not read local input.
`deskmate_console.c` is a foreground-only input adapter that maps `once` and
`deny` to the controller. Future GPIO input uses the same controller decision
API; USB CDC will be a separate newline-framed transport.

The controller keeps a local exact-prompt decision latch after a successful
send. Repeated local input for that `prompt.id` is rejected until a later
authoritative snapshot clears or replaces the prompt. The bridge remains the
final consumer and rejects all duplicate, stale, or mismatched decisions.

The app requires `CONFIG_NETUTILS_MQTTC=y` and `CONFIG_NETUTILS_CJSON=y`. For
the current LAN development broker, leave `CONFIG_NETUTILS_MQTTC_WITH_MBEDTLS`
disabled. Do not add the PC address, MQTT username, or password to source or
Kconfig. Supply them at launch:

```sh
deskmate -h <pc-lan-ip> -p 1883 -u deskmate -w <password> -d goldfish-1
```

The runtime command line exposes the password in an interactive process list;
this is acceptable only for the current simulator bring-up. Replace it with a
restricted deployment configuration before board delivery.

For the current Goldfish image, start the app after the virtual network is up:

```sh
deskmate -h <pc-lan-ip> -p 1883 -u deskmate -w <password> -d goldfish-1
```

It publishes to `deskmate/goldfish-1/device-to-bridge` and subscribes to
`deskmate/goldfish-1/bridge-to-device`. On every broker reconnect it creates a
new connection nonce, performs a new `hello` handshake, and remains Offline
until a matching snapshot arrives.

While the Goldfish app owns the NSH console, it displays a `DeskMate>` prompt.
An empty line is a no-op; type `once` or `deny` followed by Enter only for the
current approval request. This is a simulator bring-up input only; it invokes
the same exact-prompt decision path that future GPIO buttons will use.
`deskmate` must remain the foreground command while this adapter is enabled,
so it is the sole reader of stdin; no background service may read the NSH
console concurrently.

Host verification:

```sh
gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I app/deskmate \
  app/deskmate/deskmate_client.c app/deskmate/deskmate_controller.c \
  app/deskmate/test_deskmate_client.c \
  -o /tmp/deskmate-client-test && /tmp/deskmate-client-test
```

This is not USB, LCD/LED/key, or BK7258 bring-up evidence.
# DeskMate ACP bridge — PC loop milestone

The bridge is the PC-only ACP Client. It starts one backend (`mimo acp` or `kiro-cli acp`), normalizes its state, and exposes only DeskMate Link through a local Unix-domain socket or MQTT. The terminal client is an ACP-agnostic stand-in for the future OpenVela client.

The frozen link contract is [../../docs/protocol.md](../../docs/protocol.md). The client never receives ACP session IDs, raw tool arguments, credentials, or Agent-specific extension messages.

## Deterministic loop verification

```sh
cd tools/acp-bridge
npm test
npm run demo:loop
```

The fake adapter integration test proves nonce handshake, Unix socket delivery, host-side argument redaction, `ptSubmit`, exact option ID mapping, and duplicate decision suppression. It does not claim hardware or real-Agent permission control.

## Interactive PC client

In one terminal, start the bridge. `fake` is the deterministic loop backend:

```sh
node bin/deskmate-bridge.mjs --backend fake --socket /tmp/deskmate-link.sock
```

In another terminal, start the client:

```sh
node bin/deskmate-client.mjs --socket /tmp/deskmate-link.sock
```

The client sends hello with a fresh nonce and then displays `Offline`, `Idle`, `Busy`, `Attention`, or `Result` from DeskMate snapshots. Its commands are `status`, `once`, `deny`, `disconnect`, and `quit`. It has no `ptSubmit` command: only the bridge's ACP capture path can create a prompt.

For the fake demo, type `prompt` into the bridge terminal. This creates a synthetic request solely for PC-loop testing; it never runs a command. Then choose `once` or `deny` in the client terminal.

## Real ACP state-flow probe

Use a selected backend in the bridge terminal and type a prompt as bridge stdin:

```sh
node bin/deskmate-bridge.mjs --backend mimo --socket /tmp/deskmate-link.sock
node bin/deskmate-bridge.mjs --backend kiro --socket /tmp/deskmate-link.sock
```

The adapter runs `initialize`, `session/new`, and `session/prompt`, then turns `session/update` tool/text activity into DeskMate facts. A real `session/request_permission` is held until the terminal client sends `once` or `deny`; only the Agent-provided `allow_once` or `reject_once` option ID can be returned.

Known limitation: the current MiMoCode profile has been observed to complete a bash tool call without emitting `session/request_permission`. The bridge will show its state/tool result but will not invent an Attention prompt; this is not a permission-control success.

## Local MQTT transport

MQTT is the wireless DeskMate Link shared by the simulator and the real board. Run Mosquitto on the PC, then start the bridge with an explicit broker, topic prefix, and device ID:

```sh
mosquitto -p 18883 -v
node bin/deskmate-bridge.mjs --backend fake --transport mqtt \
  --broker mqtt://127.0.0.1:18883 --topic-prefix deskmate --device-id demo-1
node bin/deskmate-client.mjs --transport mqtt \
  --broker mqtt://127.0.0.1:18883 --topic-prefix deskmate --device-id demo-1
```

The bridge subscribes to `deskmate/demo-1/device-to-bridge`, publishes to `deskmate/demo-1/bridge-to-device`, and publishes non-retained `online`/LWT `offline` status to `deskmate/demo-1/status`. MQTT uses version 5, clean start, session expiry `0`, QoS `0`, and non-retained DeskMate messages. Set `DESKMATE_MQTT_USERNAME` and `DESKMATE_MQTT_PASSWORD` only through the environment when a broker requires authentication; never put credentials in commands, fixtures, or logs.

## Unified launcher

`bin/deskmate-demo.sh` shortens PC validation while keeping broker, bridge, and device/client in separate terminals. It accepts the real ACP backend and link transport as positional arguments:

```sh
# Terminal 1: local-only broker for PC validation
bin/deskmate-demo.sh broker --port 18883

# Terminal 2: use a real ACP backend over MQTT
bin/deskmate-demo.sh bridge mimo mqtt --broker mqtt://127.0.0.1:18883 --device-id goldfish-1
# Or: bin/deskmate-demo.sh bridge kiro mqtt --broker mqtt://127.0.0.1:18883 --device-id goldfish-1

# Terminal 3: PC device stand-in; later replace with the simulator or board
bin/deskmate-demo.sh client mqtt --broker mqtt://127.0.0.1:18883 --device-id goldfish-1
```

For the existing loop transport, replace the two final commands with `bridge <backend> loop` and `client loop`. Run `bin/deskmate-demo.sh --help` for all parameters. The launcher reads MQTT credentials only from `DESKMATE_MQTT_USERNAME` and `DESKMATE_MQTT_PASSWORD`.

  ```bash
  # 测试、检查后
  ```

    Add the DeskMate MQTT prototype across the PC bridge and OpenVela device
    application.
    
    PC bridge:
    - add ACP adapters for MiMoCode and Kiro
    - normalize session updates into DeskMate snapshots
    - map exact once/deny decisions back to ACP option IDs

      timeout, and duplicate-decision handling

      redacted permission hints and semantic tool titles

    - add the deskmate application and manifest mapping
    - add MQTT-C transport, protocol state core, controller, and foreground
      console adapter
    - derive Offline, Idle, Busy, Attention, and Result states locally
    - accept once/deny only for the active prompt and prevent local
    duplicate
      decisions
    - deduplicate unchanged heartbeat display updates

    2. Start the bridge:
       bin/deskmate-demo.sh bridge kiro mqtt \
         --broker mqtt://<broker-ip>:1883 --device-id goldfish-1
    3. Start the OpenVela client:
       deskmate -h <broker-ip> -p 1883 \
         -u <username> -w <password> -d goldfish-1
    4. Use the foreground DeskMate> prompt to enter once or deny when an
       Attention snapshot presents a pending permission request.

你手工创建的是：

```text
/home/czp/openvela_contest/packages/demos/contest2026_272_deskmate
  -> ../../contest2026_272_tokenwujixian/app/deskmate
```

它现在**还不能去除**。虽然本仓的 [`contest2026_272_tokenwujixian.xml`](/home/czp/openvela_contest/contest2026_272_tokenwujixian/contest2026_272_tokenwujixian.xml:13) 已经包含 DeskMate 的 `<linkfile>`，但当前工作区真正生效的 `.repo/manifests` 仍停在初始提交 `186657e`，其中没有这条映射，`.repo/copy-link-files.json` 也没有登记它。直接删除后，`menuconfig` / 构建树会再次找不到 DeskMate。

正确的清理时机是：确保你当前 workspace 使用的 manifest 分支也已包含该 `<linkfile>`，完成一次 `repo sync` 让 repo 接管生成该链接，然后验证链接仍指向 `app/deskmate`，最后才移除旧的手工目录项（若 repo sync 未自动覆盖）。

thinking: The team Git repository and the workspace manifest are separate synchronization layers. A normal repo sync updates the latter and materializes linkfiles; it does not make an old local development branch correctly correspond to an upstream PR by itself. First compare the actual upstream merge target with local branches, then choose fast-forward, reset-with-backup, or a targeted rebase based on ancestry and unique commits.

text:
不是“`repo sync` 后再统一 rebase 远程分支”。正确顺序应当是：先确认 PR 合入的**官方目标分支**，处理本地 `trunk` / `dev` 与它的关系；确认 manifest 分支也包含 `<linkfile>` 后，再执行一次 `repo sync` 来让工作区接管软链接。

关键点是：当前有两套仓库状态。

- 团队代码仓：`contest2026_272_tokenwujixian`，其中有本地 `trunk`、`dev`，以及 `openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026` 等远端引用。
- repo manifest checkout：`.repo/manifests`，它也跟踪 `openvela/contest2026_272_tokenwujixian` 的 `dev-ai-contest-2026`，但目前仍停留在初始提交。

建议流程：

```bash
# 0. 先处理/暂存当前自动导出的日志，避免 repo sync 因工作区脏状态失败
git -C contest2026_272_tokenwujixian status

# 1. 刷新“团队代码仓”的官方远端引用，只更新引用、不改工作区
git -C contest2026_272_tokenwujixian fetch openvela

# 2. 确认 PR 实际合入的目标和本地 trunk 的关系
git -C contest2026_272_tokenwujixian log --oneline --left-right \
  trunk...openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026
git -C contest2026_272_tokenwujixian diff --stat \
  trunk...openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026
```

随后按结果选择：

- 如果 `trunk` 是 `openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026` 的祖先：用 `git merge --ff-only` 更新 `trunk`。
- 如果远端 PR 是 squash / rebase 合入，导致两边提交不同、但内容等价：先留归档分支，再将本地 `trunk` 对齐到官方远端；**不要 rebase 整个旧 trunk**，否则很容易重放已合入的 DeskMate 改动。
- 如果本地确实还有 PR 之后的新提交：只将那些“PR 后新增”的提交 rebase 或 cherry-pick 到官方远端新基线。

`dev` 应该在 `trunk` 完成对齐后处理：

```bash
git -C contest2026_272_tokenwujixian diff --stat trunk...dev
git -C contest2026_272_tokenwujixian branch archive/dev-pre-upstream-sync dev
```

若确认 `dev` 只是之前那串已被 PR 整合的开发提交、没有独有新工作，则让它直接指向新的 `trunk` 即可；不应 rebase 那整串历史：

```bash
git -C contest2026_272_tokenwujixian switch dev
git -C contest2026_272_tokenwujixian reset --hard trunk
```

然后才处理 workspace manifest：

```bash
# 在外层工作区执行
cd /home/czp/openvela_contest

# 可先仅更新网络引用并检查，避免直接改工作树
repo sync -n

# 确认 .repo/manifests/contest2026_272_tokenwujixian.xml
# 已含 app/deskmate -> packages/demos/contest2026_272_deskmate 后
repo sync
```

正常 `repo sync` 会把 `<linkfile>` 物化并登记，从而接管：

```text
packages/demos/contest2026_272_deskmate
  -> ../../contest2026_272_tokenwujixian/app/deskmate
```

同步后验证即可：

```bash
rg 'contest2026_272_deskmate' .repo/manifests/contest2026_272_tokenwujixian.xml \
  .repo/copy-link-files.json
readlink packages/demos/contest2026_272_deskmate
```

不要在 `repo sync` 前手动删该软链接；让 repo 识别并重建它。验证登记成功且链接目标正确后，它就不再是 workaround，而是 manifest 正式管理的链接。

对，这个工作流更干净：**不需要同时保留本地 `trunk` 和 `dev`。**

保留一个长期活动分支即可，建议继续叫 `dev`，职责是：

- 基于官方远端 `openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026`；
- 汇总、测试、整理准备提交的改动；
- 对外作为你 fork 上的 PR 分支。

而 `openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026` 这个远程跟踪引用，本身就是官方基线，不需要额外用本地 `trunk` 再镜像一份。

你现在的状态正适合这么收敛：

```text
openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026  官方已合入的基线
dev                           唯一长期本地集成 / 提交分支
feat/*                        各项日常开发的 worktree 分支
archive/*                     已保留的旧历史，不参与日常工
stash@{0..3}                  已保留的本地日志与协议草稿
```

由于当前 `dev` 和 `trunk` 都是 `929e13d`，且都与官方远端一致，可以在 `dev` 上执行：

```bash
git branch -d trunk
```

这只会移除冗余的本地分支名，不影响：

- 官方远端引用 `openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026`
- 当前 `dev`
- `archive/trunk-pre-openvela-sync-20260806`
- 任意 stash
- 远端仓库

日常开发流程建议固定成：

```bash
# 从当前集成分支创建一个独立 worktree
git worktree add ../deskmate-<topic> -b feat/<topic> dev
```

在 `feat/<topic>` 中保留细粒度提交，例如：

```text
feat: add reconnect state
test: cover reconnect timeout
fix: reject stale hello
```

功能完成、测试通过后，回到主工作区的 `dev`，将选定提交压成一个可审阅的提交：

```bash
git switch dev
git cherry-pick --no-commit <first-commit>^..<last-commit>
git commit -s -m "feat: add DeskMate reconnect handling"
```

如果只挑其中几个提交，就逐个 `git cherry-pick --no-commit <sha>`，最后统一提交。这样 `feat/*` 保留完整开发过程，`dev` 只保留整洁、可提交的提交。

首次准备向个人 fork 推送时：

```bash
git push -u origin dev
```

之后 `dev` 会跟踪 `origin/dev`，方便推送；同步官方则始终显式以 `openvela` 为准：

```bash
git fetch openvela
git switch dev
git rebase openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026
```

这里有一个关键例外：**PR 被官方 squash 合入后，不要对已经合入的 `dev` 再做 rebase。** 像这次一样，先验证两边文件树等价：

```bash
git diff --exit-code dev openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026
```

若返回 `0`，说明官方已包含完全相同的内容，只是提交 SHA 不同。此时归档一下，再把 `dev` 直接对齐官方基线：

```bash
git branch archive/dev-before-upstream-reset-<date> dev
git reset --hard openvela/dev-ai-contest-2026
```

这正是避免 squash 合入后重复提交、重复冲突的关键。
